articles.title: Swimmer Archie Goodburn Will Carry the Rugby Ball for Scotland
articles.summary: Scottish swimmer Archie Goodburn, who came back after brain tumour surgery, will carry the match ball for Scotland against Australia at Murrayfield.

articles.title: Leon Bridges Tries a New Sound on 'Happiness Anytime'
articles.summary: Eleven years after his retro-soul debut Coming Home, Leon Bridges returns with Happiness Anytime, mixing Afrobeats, Brazilian music and disco to get listeners dancing.

articles.title: Fall Back! Daylight Saving Time Ends on November 1
articles.summary: On November 1, 2026, clocks go back an hour as Daylight Saving Time ends, giving a bonus hour and more morning light.
